lines.text: Isaac, old and unable to see, tells Esau to take his sling and hunt game so he can bless him.
Rebekah overhears Isaac and tells Jacob to bring her two choice young goats from the flock.
Rebekah dresses Jacob in Esau's finest clothes, puts lambskins on his hands and neck, and gives him food and bread.
Jacob tells Isaac he is Esau and says the LORD brought him the game, and Isaac touches his hairy hands.
Esau returns from the hunt, and Isaac trembles violently and says Esau's brother came deceitfully and took the blessing.
